defs.def: a series of movements and steps that are usually performed to music; a particular example of these movements and steps 舞蹈；舞步

ex.s: “They’re learning to do traditional dances.
ex.t: “他们在学习跳传统舞蹈。

ex.s: Practice a traditional dance.
ex.t: 练习一支传统舞蹈。

ex.s: After winning a national competition in 1986 with her Spirit of the Peacock dance, she has been known as the “Peacock Princess”.
ex.t: 1986年，她凭借孔雀舞《孔雀之灵》赢得全国比赛后，被誉为“孔雀公主”。

defs.def: the art of dancing, especially for entertainment 舞蹈（艺术）

ex.s: It presents live entertainment, including pop, rock, folk, jazz, musicals, dance, world music, films and classical music.
ex.t: 它呈献现场演出，包括流行、摇滚、民谣、爵士、音乐剧、舞蹈、世界音乐、电影和古典音乐。

ex.s: When she retired from dancing and her sons eventually flew the nest, she decided it was time to take the plunge.
ex.t: 当她告别舞蹈生涯、儿子们最终离巢独立时，她决定是时候大胆尝试了。

ex.s: The dancing club in our community welcomes all new members, ____ age or gender.
ex.t: 我们社区的舞蹈俱乐部欢迎所有新成员，无论年龄或性别。

ex.s: Sherman Cymru is excited to present a packed programme of the very best theatre, dance, family shows and music from Wales and the rest of the world.
ex.t: 舍曼·塞姆鲁兴奋地呈献一系列精彩剧目，包括最优秀的戏剧、舞蹈、家庭演出和来自威尔士及世界各地的音乐。

ex.s: Similar research has been done to understand the “neuronal fireworks” that occur when we look at inspiring sculptures, attractive faces, impressive dance, etc
ex.t: 类似的研究已经开展，以理解当我们观看鼓舞人心的雕塑、迷人的面孔、令人印象深刻的舞蹈等时产生的“神经焰火”。

ex.s: The New Theatre has been the home of quality drama, musicals, dance and children’s shows for more than 100 years.
ex.t: 百余年來，新剧院一直是优质戏剧、音乐剧、舞蹈和儿童演出的家园。

ex.s: Why does the author mention The Last Dance in the passage?
ex.t: 作者为何在文中提到《最后的舞蹈》？

ex.s: Before there was the written word, there was the language of dance.
ex.t: 在文字出现之前，就有舞蹈的语言。

ex.s: Dance expresses love and hate, joy and sorrow, life and death, and everything else in between.
ex.t: 舞蹈表达爱恨、悲喜、生死，以及其间的一切。

ex.s: “I can’t imagine doing anything else with my life.” Bridges runs dance classes for all ages.
ex.t: “我无法想象生命中还能做别的事。”布里奇斯开办面向各年龄段的舞蹈班。

ex.s: “Teaching dance is wonderful.
ex.t: “教舞蹈很棒。”

ex.s: Andrea Hillier says, “Dance, like the pattern of a beating heart, is life.
ex.t: 安德莉亚·希利尔说：“舞蹈，如同跳动心脏的规律，就是生命。”

ex.s: Dance in the US is everywhere.
ex.t: 舞蹈在美国无处不在。

ex.s: To celebrate the 2017 festival, over 1,000 Ghanaian junior high school students got up on stage to perform Chinese songs and dances.
ex.t: 为庆祝2017年节日，1000多名加纳初中生登台表演中国歌曲和舞蹈。

ex.s: The performance borrowed a lot from Chinese dance and music, so the Eastern influence on the ballet was clear.
ex.t: 这场演出大量借鉴了中国舞蹈和音乐，因此东方影响在芭蕾中显而易见。

defs.def: an act of dancing 跳舞
a social event at which people dance 舞会
a piece of music for dancing to 舞曲

ex.s: Last year, Moran worked on a project that arranged Fats Waller’s music for a dance party, “Just to kind of put it back in the mind that Waller is dance music as much as it is concert music,” says Moran.
ex.t: 去年，莫兰参与了一个项目，将法茨·沃勒的音乐改编用于舞会，“就是想让人重新意识到，沃勒的音乐既是舞曲也是音乐会音乐，”莫兰说。

defs.def: to move your body to the sound and rhythm of music 跳舞

ex.s: It made the sweetest sound I'd ever heard!My heart was dancing along with its flowing tune.
ex.t: 它发出了我听过最甜美的声音！我的心随着流畅的曲调翩翩起舞。

ex.s: “I adore dancing,” says Lester Bridges, the owner of a dance studio in Iowa.
ex.t: “我热爱跳舞，”爱荷华州一家舞蹈工作室的老板莱斯特·布里奇斯说。

ex.s: Dancing reminds me I’m alive.”
ex.t: “跳舞让我觉得自己还活着。”

ex.s: If you like dancing outdoors, come to America.
ex.t: 如果你喜欢在户外跳舞，来美国吧。

ex.s: Dancing seems to change their feeling completely.
ex.t: 跳舞似乎彻底改变了他们的感受。

ex.s: They stayed up all night long singing and dancing.
ex.t: 他们整夜不睡，又唱又跳。

ex.s: She would dance us left and right around the kitchen, our eyes _____59_____ (watch) the microwave like it was a space rocket countdown, _____60_____ (excite) and tension building to that final moment: BEEP!
ex.t: 她会绕着厨房左右舞动我们，我们的眼睛____59____（注视）着微波炉，像盯着火箭倒计时，____60____（兴奋）与紧张不断累积到那一刻：哔！

ex.s: 36    We dance from Florida to Alaska, from north to south and sea to sea.
ex.t: 36 我们从佛罗里达到阿拉斯加，从北到南、从海到海地跳舞。

ex.s: We dance at weddings, birthdays, office parties and just to fill the time.
ex.t: 我们在婚礼、生日、办公室派对上跳舞，只为打发时间。

ex.s: So, do we dance in order to make ourselves feel better, calmer, healthier?
ex.t: 那么，我们跳舞是为了让自己感觉更好、更平静、更健康吗？

ex.s: So why do we dance?
ex.t: 那么我们为何跳舞？

ex.s: People prepare decorations with flowers and dance around maypoles.
ex.t: 人们用鲜花装饰，围着五月柱跳舞。

ex.s: They sang and danced happily.
ex.t: 他们开心地又唱又跳。

defs.def: to do a particular type of dance 跳 … 舞
to move in a lively way 跳跃；雀跃；轻快地移动
